# Barry

## Personality

Mrs. Barry is characterized by her strong prejudices and deep-seated dislikes. When angered, she exhibits a cold and sullen demeanor that proves particularly difficult to overcome.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059)_

## History

Barry resided at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). His kitchen roof became the site of a disaster when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was dared to walk its ridgepole, resulting in her falling and breaking her ankle. Later, Barry drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) back home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) following their visit to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Barry is the father of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), who lives at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). His home becomes the setting for local youth gatherings, such as the party where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts a roof-walking dare and breaks her ankle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), +11 more_
